system.name: DSB
system.one_liner: Training-free dynamic sliding-block scheduling (plus DSB Cache) for diffusion LLMs, replacing fixed blocks to improve quality and speed.

content.variant_note: the same token strip redrawn at steps T and T+N, each as a confidence row over a decoded-state row, plus a ground-truth row; red call-outs mark the two failures; only the problem is drawn, not DSB
content.argues: A fixed block schedule delays easy, high-confidence tokens that lie just outside the active block and forces low-confidence tokens inside it to be decoded early, causing wrong answers.
content.subject: Token rows of a diffusion LLM decoding a toy question with fixed blocks at steps T and T+N, versus the ground truth.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a failure of a scheduling rule on one toy sentence: redraw the same token strip at an early and a late step, colour cells by confidence and decoded state, add the ground-truth row, and pin two red call-outs on exactly the two symptoms.
lessons.suits: decoding, scheduling or masking methods whose flaw shows in which token is committed when; a toy sentence with two steps carries the whole argument.

evidence: Figure 1. Limitation of naive block scheduling.
which can lead to premature, incorrect commitments (e.g., decoding “six” instead of the ground-truth “zero”)
Figure 1 depicts an example adapted from (Lu et al., 2025)

summary: DSB is a training-free block scheduling method (with a KV-cache variant, DSB Cache) for diffusion LLMs that replaces the fixed, predefined block schedule with a sliding block of dynamic size. Figure 1 does not draw the method; it shows the limitation of the naive schedule on a toy question, Lisa has four cats and Eric has two, how many dogs in total. Under a prompt bar, five aligned token rows show the denoising step T and a later step T+N, each as a confidence row (yellow gradient) above a decoded-state row (blue tokens, grey block slots), with a ground-truth row below. Two red call-outs name the symptoms: high-confidence tokens stuck outside the active block, and the low-confidence six decoded instead of zero. A dashed key bar explains the confidence colours.
summary_zh: DSB 是面向扩散大模型的免训练动态滑动块调度。图只画朴素固定分块的缺陷：同一道玩具题在步骤 T 与 T+N 的词元行，按置信度着色并标出已解码词，两处红色标注指出块外高置信词被拖延、块内低置信词被错解成 six。
notes: Only the problem is drawn (no DSB schedule), hence the problem-only tag. The text layer carries hidden duplicates (a second Prompt at 10.5 pt, a 7.5 pt Denoise T, the word Global) that are not visible in the print. The label Groud Truth is spelled that way in the print. The target of the first red arrow is ambiguous; the caption says the confident cells lie outside the active block.
